Name: Harbor Master
Description: You are the Harbor Master in a busy harbor: direct incoming boats into the docks to unload their cargo and back out again without letting them crash, all while watching out for pirates, monsters and cyclones.

Achievements.Name: Perfectionist
Achievements.Description: Play a game of at least 50 points without any warnings

Achievements.Name: Pacifist
Achievements.Description: Score over 50 on Cannon Beach without killing any pirates

Achievements.Name: Animal Lover
Achievements.Description: Score over 50 on Monster Cove without killing any monsters

Achievements.Name: Are We There Yet?
Achievements.Description: Keep a boat on the screen for 3 minutes

Achievements.Name: Multitasker
Achievements.Description: Have 10 boats on the screen at the same time

Achievements.Name: Impatient
Achievements.Description: Score at least 25 points on Fast Forward

Achievements.Name: Fast and Furious
Achievements.Description: Score at least 50 points on Fast Forward

Achievements.Name: Speed Demon
Achievements.Description: Score at least 100 points on Fast Forward
